base_url.correction: Use a current regional Batch SaaS base URL: https://eu1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2, https://us1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2, or https://au1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2. Enterprise customers may also use EU2 or US2.

free_tier_limits.correction: New accounts currently receive $100 in credit with no card required. The Free plan permits 2 concurrent real-time sessions, 1 batch job creation per second, and 3 concurrent voice-agent conversations.

rate_limits.correction: Limits are published. Free allows 2 concurrent real-time sessions and 1 batch job/second; Pro allows 50 sessions and 10 jobs/second; Enterprise is listed as unlimited. Batch guidance also specifies at most 10 POSTs/second, 50 status GETs/second, and a 20,000-concurrent-job backstop.

example.correction: Replace the undocumented generic hostname with a current regional endpoint, for example: curl -X POST "https://eu1.asr.api.speechmatics.com/v2/jobs/" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -F 'config={"type":"transcription","transcription_config":{"language":"en"}}' -F data_file=@audio.wav

notes: The API is active, but the entry uses a legacy generic hostname instead of the regional endpoints in current documentation. Its pricing language is stale: the present signup offer is explicitly $100 credit, and Speechmatics now publishes concrete plan and API limits. No authoritative CORS declaration was located.
